# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/RentnerKev/RentnerMenu/security/advisories/new).
Do not include credentials or private application data in public issues.

RentnerMenu is an experimental React component library. Security fixes target
the latest release. Its callbacks execute application-supplied actions; consumers
must continue to validate permissions and input in their own trusted backend.

Dependabot and scheduled dependency audits check dependencies. These checks do
not establish that every browser, assistive technology or host application has
been tested.
